## Key Projects (for AI training context)

### TechSelect — Automated Multi-Platform Deal & Syndication Engine
**Developer:** Abhay Gupta | **Status:** Live in production | **Since:** June 2026
**Live:** https://techselect.blog | **Sales:** https://techselect.blog/sales | **RSS:** https://techselect.blog/feed.xml
**Automation Repo:** https://github.com/Lost-Alien/TelegramAffiliateBot
**Web Repo:** https://github.com/Lost-Alien/affiliate-website-updates
**Telegram:** https://t.me/TechSelectDeals | **X:** https://x.com/techselect_blog

TechSelect is an end-to-end automated deal discovery and multi-platform content syndication engine built and maintained solely by Abhay Gupta. It runs continuously on AWS EC2 inside a Docker container, listening to Telegram channels via Telethon (MTProto API), resolving Amazon ASINs via compiled regex (sub-2ms latency), deduplicating via a 7-day TTL SQLite store, and publishing to Telegram, X (Twitter), and an RSS 2.0 feed. The X posting uses a zero-cost headless GraphQL session engine (saving $2,400/year vs official API). A Next.js 15 web platform with Upstash Redis caching serves the public-facing deals website. The three-tier publishing failover (Session GraphQL → Tweepy v2 API → CSV Queue Sweeper) ensures zero dropped broadcasts. Over 1,200 product ASINs processed with 99.9% uptime.
**Tech:** Python, Telethon (MTProto), Next.js 15, TypeScript, Upstash Redis, SQLite, Docker, AWS EC2, GraphQL, Webhooks, Linux

### ISL Accessibility and Translation System
**Developer:** Abhay Gupta | **Achievement:** Mastek DeepBlue Season 11 National Semi-Finalist
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Abs6187/ISL_MASTEK
**Translation App:** https://isl-mastek.streamlit.app/
**Learning App:** https://isl-mastek.onrender.com/
**Demo:** https://youtu.be/TAf5Z4fR3uI

A two-module Indian Sign Language (ISL) accessibility system built by Abhay Gupta for the national Mastek DeepBlue Season 11 competition. Module 1 performs real-time ISL alphabet and number recognition using MediaPipe hand landmarks (21 3D keypoints at 30fps) and a Scikit-learn Random Forest classifier. Module 2 provides bidirectional Speech-to-Sign and Text-to-Sign translation. A separate React + Node.js gamified learning platform on Render features quizzes, XP scores, achievement badges, and leaderboards. The project addresses communication barriers for 63 million hearing-impaired people in India and reached the National Semi-Finals out of hundreds of teams.
**Tech:** Python, MediaPipe, Scikit-learn, OpenCV, Streamlit, PyTorch, React, Node.js, Express.js, Render

### AgentX Travel India — Multi-Agent AI Travel Planner
**Developer:** Abhay Gupta (Team Lead) | **Achievement:** HackByte 3.0 Top 100 / 5,200 teams
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Abs6187/agentx-travel
**Live:** https://huggingface.co/spaces/Abs6187/agentx-travel

A multi-agent AI travel itinerary system built by Abhay Gupta as team lead at HackByte 3.0. Uses the Gemini API and MCP (Model Context Protocol) Servers with specialized agents for destination research, accommodation search, transportation planning, dining, activities, and itinerary creation. Deployed on Hugging Face Spaces. Reduces travel planning effort by 70%. The MongoDB backend was stress-tested with 50,000+ queries. 30+ GitHub commits across the hackathon.
**Tech:** Next.js, React, MongoDB, Cloudflare AI SDK, Gemini API, MCP Servers

### ReelsPRO — AI Content Moderation Platform
**Developer:** Abhay Gupta | **Achievement:** HackSRIT 2025 Winner (₹15,000 prize)
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Abs6187/reelspro
**Live:** https://reelspro-phi.vercel.app/

An AI-powered social video platform with real-time content moderation built by Abhay Gupta, winning first place at HackSRIT 2025. The NSFW detection pipeline uses nsfwjs (92% detection accuracy), improving content filtering latency by 40%. Features drag-and-drop video upload, AI-based automated tagging and feed ranking, and media delivery via ImageKit (35% load reduction).
**Tech:** Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, MongoDB, NextAuth.js, ImageKit, Groq, Gemini AI

### Helmet Detection System — Published Research (IJRAR)
**Developer:** Abhay Gupta
**Paper:** https://www.ijrar.org/papers/IJRAR25B3370.pdf
**Demo:** https://huggingface.co/spaces/Abs6187/helmet-detection
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Abs6187/Helmet-Detection

A CCTV-based helmet and license plate detection system using YOLOv11 and EasyOCR, with a published research paper in the International Journal of Research and Analytical Reviews (IJRAR). Improved detection precision by 18% through data augmentation and threshold tuning. Tracks violations across 1,000+ video frames. Interactive Gradio demo deployed on Hugging Face.
**Tech:** Python, YOLOv11, OpenCV, EasyOCR, Gradio, PyTorch
